map.支持 URL 组件编码（encodeURIComponent）与完整 URL 解: Supports URL component encoding (encodeURIComponent) and full URL parsing.
map.参数构造：把用户输入拼进查询参数前转义，避免 &/= 截断。: Parameter construction: escape user input before concatenating into query params, avoiding &/= truncation.
map.日志还原：把服务端记录的编码 URL 解码回可读地址便于排查。: Log restore: decode the encoded URL logged by the server back to a readable address for troubleshooting.
map.接口联调：核对前端实际发送的请求行是否符合预期。: API integration: verify the actual request line the frontend sends matches expectation.

map.后者转义更彻底（含 ?#/等），适合编码单个参数值；前者保留 URL 结构字符。: The latter escapes more thoroughly (including ?#/), suited for encoding a single parameter value; the former keeps URL structural characters.
